title: Audit Engram's existing test portfolio after sync
outcome: Audit Engram's existing test portfolio after sync
acceptance: Engram's existing tests are reviewed by suite and concrete case, with keep, simplify or remove recommendations and reasons
Each recommendation addresses the protected observable behavior, implementation-detail brittleness, cost or timeout versus benchmark character, and duplication or cheaper available proof
Prioritized findings have named Sol/Opus implementation owners and introduce no new gate
The source_file_size removal is reused, not repeated, and the audit does not block current sync landings
